question: By what factor did molecular distillation raise the α-terpineol percentage of the light fraction over the niaouli oil residue?
rendered:
According to the document, the α-terpineol percentage in the niaouli oil residue (NOR) was 36.52% (Table 4). After molecular distillation, the α-terpineol percentage in the light fraction (LF) was 66.10% (Table 4). 

To find the factor by which molecular distillation raised the α-terpineol percentage, we divide the α-terpineol percentage in the LF by the α-terpineol percentage in the NOR: 

66.10% / 36.52% ≈ 1.81
